knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Set a working directory & Load Required Packages
```{r}
setwd(".../Location")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

## Import Dataset
```{r}
# Read CSV file with multiple replicates
full_data <- read_csv("...file.csv", col_names = TRUE)  # Ensure headers are read
```

## Perform Linear Regression for Each Replicate
```{r}
# Filter only selected depths for regression based on points chosen to calculate slope
filtered_data <- full_data %>%
  filter(depth %in% c(0, 0.02, 0.04)) 

# Ensure correct pairing of depth and oxygen values
regression_results <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(rep) %>%
  summarise(
    depth_start = min(depth),
    depth_end = max(depth),
    O2_start = O2_concentration[depth == depth_start],
    O2_end = O2_concentration[depth == depth_end],
    slope = coef(lm(O2_concentration ~ depth))[2]
  )
```

## Calculate Oxygen Flux using Fick's Law
```{r}
# Given diffusion coefficient (cm²/s)
D <- 0.000022921

# Calculate flux using Fick's First Law: J = -D * (dC/dx)
regression_results <- regression_results %>%
  mutate(O2_flux = -D * slope)

# Print Fick's First Law equation with variables
regression_results <- regression_results %>%
  mutate(equation = paste0("J = -", D, " * (", O2_end, " - ", O2_start, ") / (", depth_end, " - ", depth_start, ")"))

# Display results
print(regression_results %>% select(rep, depth_start, depth_end, O2_start, O2_end, slope, O2_flux, equation))
```


## Plot the Data and Regression Lines
```{r}
# Create plot with separate regression lines for each replicate
plot <- ggplot(full_data, aes(x = O2_concentration, y = depth, color = factor(rep))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(data = filtered_data, method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(group = rep)) +
  scale_y_reverse() + #limits = c(0.04, -0.2)
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Oxygen Concentration (umol/L)",
       y = "Depth (cm)",
       color = "Replicate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -2, size = 20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = -2, colour = "black", size = 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 20),
        axis.ticks.length.x = unit(.2, "cm"),
        axis.line.x.top = element_line(),
        axis.line.y.left = element_line(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5), axis.ticks.length = unit(.2, "cm"),
        axis.title.x.top = element_text()) +
  scale_x_continuous(position = "top") #limits = c(0, 300)
# Display plot
plot
ggsave("...file.png", width=10, height=7)
```
